about.full:
I'm **Nicola Amoruso**, a Full Stack Web Developer focused on **Backend and Artificial Intelligence**, based in Valencia, Venezuela.

I have experience leading backend projects, artificial intelligence integration, and scalable architectures. I'm a **Computer Engineering** student at Universidad José Antonio Páez (2023–2027), self-taught, with a proven ability to deliver end-to-end solutions: from database design to modern interfaces and production deployment.

Practical experience with **RAG systems**, **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, **Redis caching**, and cloud ecosystems. At LegalTec, as Backend and AI Lead, I built a RAG system from scratch for legal document processing, orchestrated the integration of multiple LLMs (Anthropic Claude, open source, and local models), and led the complete backend refactoring with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript.

**Key skills:** React, Next.js 14, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis, Google Cloud, Docker, Vercel, CI/CD, REST API integration, JWT/OAuth authentication, and agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).

**Languages:** Native Spanish · B1 English (oral and written technical communication, meetings with international teams).

projects.title: LegalTec
projects.description:
LegalTec is a legal platform that bridges justice and technology, enabling users to find verified lawyers, access advanced legal tools, and perform intelligent searches across legal documents.

Built with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript on the backend, React on the frontend, Redis for caching, and Google Cloud for infrastructure. As Backend and AI Lead, I built a RAG system from scratch for semantic search, orchestrated multiple LLMs evaluating performance and cost, and integrated PayPal payments, automated backups, and secure authentication flows.

projects.title: Amoruso Inversiones
projects.description:
Amoruso Inversiones is a quote management system for an automotive workshop that enables creating estimates, automating tax calculations, and managing clients and vehicles from a single centralized interface.

Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS on the frontend, Node.js and Supabase (PostgreSQL) on the backend. Digital approvals via WhatsApp accelerate the quoting workflow, and automated deployment with Vercel and GitHub keeps the system up to date in production.

projects.title: Show Proba
projects.description:
Show Proba is a web platform for an event equipment rental catalog, where clients can browse inventory, discover trending gear, and request quotes instantly.

Developed with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with Supabase as the content manager and database. The responsive design and direct WhatsApp integration turn catalog browsing into fast quotes, with service coverage across multiple cities.
